questions.question: The Mines and Minerals (Development and Regulation) Amendment Bill, 2021 was introduced in Lok Sabha on 15 March 2021, which amended the Mines and Minerals (Development and Regulation) Act, _________.
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**1957**__. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Mines and Minerals (Development and Regulation) Act, 1957** regulates the mining sector in India.
 
• The amendment proposes to allow captive miners of both coal and other minerals to sell up to** 50 percent** of their production after meeting the requirements of the end-use plant and paying additional royalty to the state government. 
 
• Operators are currently only allowed to use **coal and minerals **extracted from captive mines for their own industrial use. 
 
• This increased flexibility would allow miners to **maximize output** from captive mines as they would be able to sell output in excess of their own requirements.
 
• The amendment also proposes to** fix additional royalty payments to states** for the extension of mining leases for central public sector enterprises.
 
• Another key change the Bill proposes is to **empower the central government to conduct auctions or re-auction processes** for the grant of a mining lease if a state government fails to complete the auction process in a specified period, decided after consultations between the Centre and state.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The Ministry of Mines, a branch of the Government of India, functions as the primary body for the **formulation and administration of laws relating to mines in India**. 
 
• The head of the ministry is **Pralhad Joshi**, who has been serving since June 2019.

questions.question: On 9 August 2021, the Parliament had passed the Limited Liability Partnership (Amendment) Bill, 2021. It amended the:
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**Limited Liability Partnership Act, 2008**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The Parliament passed the Limited Liability Partnership (Amendment) Bill, 2021 on 9 August 2021.
 
• This bill amended the **Limited Liability Partnership Act, 2008**.
 
• The amendments aimed to decriminalize several offenses under the act and introduce new concepts like small LLPs.
 
• These changes were intended to improve the ease of doing business for LLPs in India.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The Limited Liability Partnership (LLP) Act, 2008 was enacted to introduce and legally recognize the concept of LLPs in India.
 
• An LLP is a hybrid structure that combines the advantages of both a company and a partnership.
 
• It provides the benefit of limited liability to its partners while allowing them the flexibility of organizing their internal structure as a partnership.
 
• The 2021 amendment was part of the government's broader initiative to reform corporate laws and improve the business environment.

questions.question: As of 30 April 2020, who among the following was the Chairman of’ the Eastern Zonal Council?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**Amit Shah**__.

__
 
• **As of 30 April 2020, Amit Shah was the Chairman of the Eastern Zonal Council.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Zonal Councils:**

 
 
• The Zonal Councils are the **statutory bodies.**
 
• They are established by the **States Reorganisation Act of 1956**.
 
• The act divided the country into five zones i.e. **Northern, Central, Eastern, Western and Southern.**
 
• Each zonal council consists of the following members:
 
 
• The home minister of the Central government.
 
• Chief ministers of all the States in the zone.
 
• Two other ministers from each state in the zone.
 
• The Administrator of each union territory in the zone.
 
 
 
• The **Union Home Minister** is** ex-officio Chairman of the Zonal Councils.**

questions.question: The Weapons of Mass Destruction and their Delivery Systems (Prohibition of Unlawful Activities) Amendment Bill 2022 has amended in _____.

options.text: Weapons, Hazardous Chemicals and Destruction Act, 2010
Prohibition of Dangerous Weapons of Mass Destruction Act, 2014
Prohibition of Biochemical Mass Destruction Act, 2007
Weapons of Mass Destruction and their Delivery Systems (Prohibition of Unlawful Activities) Act, 2005

questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**Weapons of Mass Destruction and their Delivery Systems (Prohibition of Unlawful Activities) Act, 2005.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **​Weapons of Mass Destruction and their Delivery Systems (Prohibition of Unlawful Activities) Amendment Bill 2022:-**

 
 
• The Weapons of Mass Destruction and their Delivery Systems (Prohibition of Unlawful Activities) Amendment Bill 2022 was amended on 6th August 2022.
 
• **The Bill was introduced in the Lok Sabha on April 5, 2022, and was passed by both houses of Parliament with a voice vote.**
 
• The Act amends the Weapons of Mass Destruction and their Delivery Systems (Prohibition of Unlawful Activities) Act, 2005, to:
 
 
• Prohibit the financing of any activity related to weapons of mass destruction (WMDs) and their delivery systems.
 
• Empower the government to seize, freeze, or attach the economic resources and financial assets of those engaged in prohibited activities.
 
• Provide for integrated legal measures to control the export of materials, equipment, and technologies related to WMDs and their delivery systems.
 
• Prevent the transfer of WMDs and their delivery systems to non-State actors or terrorists
